_comment_deepseek: DeepSeek HTTP backend. Leave deepseek_api_key empty (or set to ${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY}) to disable. When set, a 'deepseek' BackendSpec is auto-registered and /d /deepseek shortcuts become active.
_comment_injection_gate: P0 injection gate — api_skip_recent_turns_when_history (default true): skip the 100 KB recent-turns disk read when the target backend is an API backend (anthropic_api / google_api / openai_compat_api). These backends carry conversation history structurally via load_history() and already ignore recent_turns in _run_backend_single, so the pre-read is pure I/O waste. Set false to restore pre-gate behaviour.
_comment_injection_gates_p1: P1 on-demand injection gates. **project_guide_enabled** (now recommended true): when enabled with project_guide_path set, the file at project_guide_path (≤4000 chars, truncated beyond) is prepended for non-claude-cli backends; with project_guide_auto_discover=true and no path set, auto-discovers CLAUDE.md or .larkhelm_project.md from cwd instead. All gates emit larkhelm_injection_gate_total{point, outcome} regardless of prometheus-client availability.
_comment_project_guide_auto_discover: Auto-discover project guide from cwd: tries CLAUDE.md then .larkhelm_project.md. Only active when project_guide_enabled=true and project_guide_path is empty.
_comment_injection_gates_p2: P2/P3 injection gates. parent_inject_skip_when_api_history (default false): skip parent-message text fetch for API backends (anthropic_api / google_api / openai_compat_api) that already carry conversation history structurally — saves ~100-500 duplicate input tokens. Crew context fallback still runs regardless. doc_inject_relevance_gate_enabled (default false): when true, uses embedding cosine similarity to gate doc injection — sim < doc_inject_relevance_threshold (0.3) skips body and injects title-only hint; 0.3 ≤ sim < 0.6 truncates to max_chars // 2; sim ≥ 0.6 injects full content. Fails open (sim=1.0) when embedding is unavailable. New metric outcomes: skipped_by_relevance, truncated_by_relevance.
_comment_doc_inject_backend_ttl: Per-backend doc inject cache TTL (seconds). When set, overrides the global doc_inject_cache_ttl_sec for that specific backend on cache lookups. Shorter TTL for Kimi/DeepSeek reduces stale content risk; longer for Claude matches its 1h extended cache benefit.
_comment_memory_phase_b: Phase B memory token-optimization (S49–S53). All flags default to true; flip individually to bisect a token regression without redeploying. memory_session_gc_enabled triggers a daemon that unlinks session_*.md older than memory_session_gc_max_age_days.
_comment_memory_recent_turns_dedup: P0-3 已接通真实 dedup 路径（之前仅占位）：log._get_recent_turns 接收 dedup_prefix=session.work_context，命中前 60 字符匹配的 turn 会被跳过。
_comment_feishu_doc_perm: M-DOC-PERM: doc visibility and auto-collaborators. feishu_doc_default_vis sets the initial visibility of newly created docs ('' = use Feishu API default). feishu_doc_collaborators is a list of open_ids added as 'view' collaborators right after creation — useful when the org restricts doc sharing by default.
_comment_p1: P1 iteration knobs (all disabled by default). health_endpoint_port=0 disables the HTTP /health /ready /metrics endpoint (Prometheus-compatible); set a port > 0 (eg. 9300) and configure your reverse proxy to scrape it. health_bind_addr defaults to 127.0.0.1 — DO NOT bind 0.0.0.0 unless behind an authenticated proxy. query_session_v2_enabled enables the QuerySession rewrite of _do_query (PR2, default false). memory_session_layer_smart enables three-section smart_truncate per memory_session_layer_budgets (default true; flip to false for byte-compat with pre-P1). memory_cascade_midflight_cancel makes background memory extracts abort their LLM call as soon as a new chat turn lands (default true; flip false to fall back to post-LLM cancel only).
_comment_p2: P2 iteration knobs. metrics_text_legacy=true forces /metrics to the P1 hand-written exposition even when prometheus-client is installed (useful when bisecting a metrics regression).
_comment_week3: Week-3 optimisations: session guard for all backends + cache-savings metrics + TTL-based extended cache retry. session_guard_enabled=true activates auto-reset for all CLI backends (claude/gemini/deepseek/kimi) when their per-chat counters cross the thresholds in session_guard_policies; set false to disable entirely (claudeSessionAutoReset still governs the old claude-only path). session_guard_checkpoint_before_reset=true (default) generates a ≤300-char LLM summary of recent turns and writes it to DATA_DIR/.feishu_sessions/{chat_id}.anchor.json before the reset so the next session can prepend it as a [Session Anchor: …] context hint. session_guard_policies lets you customise per-backend thresholds: max_cache_read_tokens (cumulative cache-read tokens across turns) and max_turns (number of record_token_usage calls). anthropic_extended_cache_retry_sec controls how long the process waits before retrying the Anthropic extended-cache beta after a 400 rejection (default 1800 = 30 min); set 0 to disable TTL gating and fall back to pre-Week-3 permanent-disable behaviour.
_comment_week4: Week-4: Cross-Backend Session Guard + Anthropic Layered Cache Control. anthropic_layered_cache_control_enabled=false (default) keeps byte-identical behaviour. Set true to split system prompt into stable (global+project memory) and volatile (session memory) cache_control blocks, improving Anthropic prompt-cache prefix hit rate when session memory changes between turns.
_comment_week6: Week-6: Ops graduation + Cache system finish. (REQ-02) session_guard_min_turns_before_reset=5 prevents auto-reset on very new sessions (turns < threshold → guard skips); set 0 or 1 to disable protection. (REQ-03) anthropic_layered_cache_traffic=0.0 controls probabilistic layered-cache rollout: 0.0=off, 1.0=all traffic; anthropic_layered_cache_control_enabled=true overrides to 100%. (REQ-04) session_guard_checkpoint_turns=5 controls how many recent turns generate_session_checkpoint reads before reset; floor=1. (REQ-05) cache_hit_rate_alert_threshold=0.5 emits a debug log when per-query cache hit rate falls below this fraction (only when cache_read>0); set 0.0 to silence.
_comment_backend_aware_budget: Week-2: Backend-aware memory context budget. backend_aware_budget_enabled=false (default) keeps all backends on the POLICY_TABLE baseline budget — no behaviour change. Set true to scale memory injection budget by context-window tier: ≥256K (Gemini/Kimi) +20%, ≥64K (mid-tier) unchanged, <64K (small-window) −30%. context_window_<id>=0 means use built-in DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOWS value; set a positive integer (tokens) to override. Changes take effect on the next query — no restart needed.
_comment_admin_cards: P3 REQ-07 / P1-1a — orange admin cards for diagnostic failures. plugin_report_card_enabled pushes boot-time plugin load failures (PluginLoadReport) to admin_chat_id; failure_report_card_enabled is the P1-1a generic failure_report.emit() entry point (cascade backoff exhausted / circuit open / etc., wired in P1-1b/c). Both default false to stay byte-compatible. admin_chat_id is the target chat for both.
_comment_metrics_alert: REQ-15: metrics alert daemon settings. When enabled, larkhelm monitors key metrics and sends alert cards to admin_chat_id when thresholds are exceeded. Alerts are throttled to at most one per metrics_alert_interval_sec per metric.
_comment_probe_models: Optional. If omitted, installed CLIs are auto-discovered from PATH (no model pinning or capabilities). Uncomment and customize to pin models and enable orchestrator routing hints.

probe_models._comment: DeepSeek via HTTP. Auto-registered when deepseek_api_key is non-empty; this explicit entry only matters if you want to pin a different model or set a custom base_url per backend. cost_per_1k_* + capability_scores + latency_tier let intent_router L2 cheap-tier auto-select DeepSeek when Gemini-flash is unavailable. NOTE: do NOT add 'tools' to tags — the HTTP runner does not implement function calling, and adding it would let rank_for_task pick DeepSeek for require_tools=True tasks.
probe_models.capabilities: Cheap, fast Chinese-friendly chat model. Good for high-volume drafting and summarization where Claude/Gemini cost is wasteful.
probe_models._cost_comment: USD per 1K tokens (cache-miss rate; Apr-2026 list price). Update if DeepSeek changes pricing.

_comment_claude_workflow_enabled: Claude Code Workflow (multi-agent orchestration, claude CLI >= 2.1.154). Default false: a single workflow can burn hundreds of thousands of tokens, so it must be explicitly opted in. When true, /ultra <task> rewrites the prompt with the ultracode keyword and Workflow(*) is added to the permission allow list; when false, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1 hard-disables the tool even under skip_permissions.
